sloka: अग्निष्टोमो ऽश्वमेधश्च यज्ञो बहुसुवर्णकः ।राजसूयस्तथा यज्ञो गोमेधो वैष्ववस्तथा ।। ७.२५.८ ॥
transliteration: agniṣṭomo 'śvamedhaśca yajño bahusuvarṇakaḥ ।rājasūyastathā yajño gomedho vaiṣvavastathā ।। 7.25.8 ॥

translations.english: The Agnishtoma, Ashwamedha, Bahusuvarnaka, Rajasuya, Gomedha, and Vaishvava are all types of sacrifices.
